setup_guide.introduction: Please upload a de-identified CT file (.nii or .nii.gz) using Upload CT below. This co-worker is for research and education only, not for real diagnosis or treatment.

real.introduction: Upload a CT volume, then choose the anatomy present in the scan.

fields.label: CT file
fields.description: Upload a de-identified 3D .nii or .nii.gz CT with Hounsfield units (64 MiB compressed, 256 MiB expanded maximum). Not for real diagnosis.

fields.label: Anatomy region
fields.description: Choose the region present in the uploaded CT.

starter_questions: How do I upload a CT scan?
Explain the research report and its uncertainty.
